title: Jhin Laugh
blurb: Jhin is League of Legends' serial-killer artist: four shots, an obsession with the number four, and a laugh suggesting the entire match is a piece he happens to be composing. It comes out soft, breathy and genuinely unsettling — Riot's voice direction on him is some of the best writing in the game, and the laugh is the moment the performance slips. Nearly five seconds, which is a long time to be laughed at. Ideal for lurking in a Discord call, or reacting to a plan going suspiciously well.
origin: Jhin's laugh from League of Legends (Riot Games).
